name: repo-platform-sync-pr
description: Handle an automated repo-platform template sync PR: triage the body, review every file, resolve conflicts, and recover a broken sync.

interface.shortDescription: Review and repair repo-platform template sync PRs.
interface.longDescription: The playbook for the automation-branch PRs repo-platform pushes into managed repos: a mandatory per-file review pass, correct conflict resolution per file class, prompt fix-and-merge on the rolling branch, and the recover=recopy escalation for an unusable recorded base.
defaultPrompt: Handle the repo-platform bot PR that just arrived.
The sync PR reports merge conflicts - resolve them.
The template update PR deleted my local section.
